prompt:
Design a world-class, ultra-clean Minimalist Technical Studio interface for 'SCME-AWN: Smart Campus AI Management System' (Desktop 1440px viewport, Vercel/Swiss style dark theme).

AESTHETIC & PHILOSOPHY:
- Swiss-style precision, Vercel-inspired monochrome technical aesthetic.
- Zero clutter, zero bubbly cards, zero generic gradients.
- Structural layout constructed with razor-thin 1px grid hair-lines (#262626 / #1F1F1F) and generous, deliberate negative space.
- Background: Pure Deep Black #000000 and Charcoal Surfaces (#0A0A0A, #111111, #171717).
- Typography-First Architecture:
  • Headlines & Display: Track-tight modern grotesque sans (Geist / Outfit / Satoshi), high-contrast white #EDEDED, weight-driven hierarchy.
  • Subtext & Controls: Muted neutral gray #888888 and #A1A1A1.
  • Telemetry & Hashes: Crisp tabular JetBrains Mono (#FAFAFA / #737373) for timestamps, counts, and cryptographic hashes.
- Single Disciplined Accent: Crimson Rose #F43F5E used with strict restraint for the SCME-AWN logo emblem, key CTAs, and active pulse pips.
- Semantic Status Dots (Minimalist 4px pips with status text):
  • #10B981 Emerald for 0-Clash Timetables.
  • #F59E0B Amber for Warden Review.
  • #EF4444 Crimson for Density Anomaly.

LAYOUT & MODULES:
1. Minimal Header & Identity:
   - Left: SCME-AWN square crimson emblem + bold minimalist text 'SCME-AWN' | 'CAMPUS OS / 2.4'.
   - Center: Clean hairline-bordered quick switcher ('All Zones', 'Fall 2026', 'CSP Engine v2').
   - Right: Real-time clock (JetBrains Mono UTC/Local), keyboard search shortcut ('⌘K'), and minimalistic user status.
2. Top Metric Matrix (Clean 4-column hairline grid divided by 1px vertical borders, not boxes):
   - 'OCCUPANCY RATE' -> 84.6% (+3.2% 24h delta, micro mono sparkline)
   - 'CSP SCHEDULES' -> 1,248 / 1,248 Periods (0 CLASHES GUARANTEED)
   - 'GATE PASSES' -> 412 ISSUED (18 ACTIVE IN-TRANSIT)
   - 'COGNITIVE INDEX' -> 91.2% RETENTION (KDPA SPACED DECAY)
3. Central Intelligence Workspace (Asymmetric Split with 1px border dividers):
   - Left (8 cols): 'Campus Pulse & Zone Occupancy Flow'
     • Architectural hairline blueprint wireframe of campus zones (Library, Engineering Block, Cafeteria, Labs).
     • Precision live occupancy gauges and a minimal SVG line curve showing 3-hour predictive density.
   - Right (4 cols): 'CSP Timetable Engine & Room Allocation'
     • Clean tabular upcoming schedule slots with faculty ID, room code (LH-101, LAB-302), and instantaneous 0-clash verified badge.
     • Minimalist action button: '⚡ Optimize Allocations'.
4. Lower Operational Stream (High-Density Minimalist Data Table):
   - No row borders, subtle hover row highlight (#141414).
   - Columns: Student ID (Mono), Name, Destination, Departure Time (Mono), Cryptographic Signature Hash (Truncated Mono), Status Pip, Action menu (...).
